notes.title: Last Stitch Goodnight Launches on Steam!
notes.content:
WE LIIIIIVE!  After 6 years, Last Stitch Goodnight is finally here!  Here are some pro tips to help you get started!

1) Difficulty 
There are three levels, choose wisely!

Easy - Enemies mostly stay dead, so if you clear a room, it stays pretty clear. Enemies also do less damage, and you are more likely to find health if you are hurt.

Medium - Normal damage all around, and when you revisit a room there is a 50% chance an enemy will come back to life.

Hard - Enemies do EXTRA damage, and always come back to life when you revisit a room.  GOOD LUCK!

2) Weapons
Most of the weapons have a special attack you can incorporate into your attacks!  Check out (and print out!) the LSG Manual to help learn them!

https://wellbredrhino.com/last-stitch-goodnight-manual/

3) Enemies
You can duck to dodge some projectiles, and others you can hit out of the air with your weapon!  For head on blunt force attacks, however, you will need to learn the "jump back" move to make sure you can get to safety!

4) Support
Contact me through the Well Bred Rhino website for ANY concerns!

https://wellbredrhino.com/

notes.title: Last Stitch Goodnight Birthday Party Invitation
notes.content:
Well Bred Rhino is EXTREMELY EXCITED to announce the Last Stitch Goodnight launch date!  The terrible monstrosities of Last Stitch Goodnight escape on May 9th, 2017.  On this fateful day players will be able to fight their way through Dr. Dooley’s horrible experimentations, discover new weapons, and unlock new powers.   After 5 thrilling years of development, this action/adventure/metroidvania/weird thing is finally coming to Steam and PS4.  

“This game has turned out to be everything I could have imagined, literally,” said Ben Cook, Lead Designer of Well Bred Rhino. “In addition to the giant story, we have hidden secrets all throughout the mansion, challenging the player’s curiosity and problem solving ability.  We made sure we held nothing back, and we can’t wait for everyone to enjoy it.” 

Last Stitch Goodnight is rated "T" for Teen.  If you'd like to learn more, please visit the Well Bred Rhino website at wellbredrhino.com.

notes.title: Last Stitch Goodnight Kickstarter is ALIIIIIIVE!
notes.content:
After years of blood, sweat, and coffee, Well Bred Rhino can’t wait for everyone to get their hands on Last Stitch Goodnight. The main storyline is completely done, and more side missions are in the works. But there is one thing the game needs that no amount of caffeine can provide: a soundtrack. To help give Last Stitch Goodnight the music it deserves, Well Bred Rhino needs your help!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1787267983/last-stitch-goodnight] http://store.steampowered.com/app/509620 [/url]

This Kickstarter campaign gives everyone a chance to help take part in the development process, uncover a few of the Doctor’s mysteries, and walk away with some fantastic rewards, like the newly made soundtrack, an art book, or a special appearance in the game! With your support, we can make the game something truly memorable with an amazing soundtrack!
